response.justification: Bogdan brings deep expertise in geospatial data platforms and high-scale distributed systems, combined with a strong focus on software craftsmanship and automated testing. While his recent experience leans heavily toward TypeScript, Node.js, and DLang rather than modern C++ or Rust, his foundational C++ background, domain knowledge in GIS, and proven ability to build low-latency infrastructure make him a candidate with high potential to adapt to the role's requirements.
strengths: Extensive experience building and maintaining geospatial data platforms (GISCollective, Green Map).
Proven track record with high-scale, low-latency distributed systems, handling millions of requests per second.
Strong engineering practices with deep expertise in automated testing, CI/CD, and software craftsmanship.
concerns: Lacks recent professional experience with modern C++ or Rust, relying primarily on TypeScript, Node.js, and DLang.
C++ experience is somewhat dated, having last been used professionally around 2014-2015.
While highly experienced in GIS, there is no direct mention of building routing data pipelines or navigation algorithms.
